A [[helmet]]ed '''Klatooinian''' was a member of [[Silvo's pirates]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. Around [[9 ABY]], the individual was present at [[Borgo Prime|Starport Borgo]] when the mutinied [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]] escaped from his [[brig]]. Some [[time]] later, the [[Klatooinian]] attended [[Trial of Silvo|Silvo's trial]], which concluded with the defendant's [[Death penalty|death sentence]] being postponed for the time being. After Silvo [[Blaster|shot]] his successor [[Brutus]] to regain command of the crew, the helmeted [[pirate]] took part in the [[Invasion of At Attin]], which ended in defeat for the invaders with the arrival of a [[New Republic]] [[squadron]].

==Biography==
A [[helmet]]ed [[Klatooinian]] [[pirate]] was a member of [[Silvo's pirates]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="SC 102" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the crew mutinied against [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]], with [[Brutus]] ascending to the position of Captain.<ref name="SC 102">{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}}</ref>

The individual was present at former Captain [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]]'s [[Trial of Silvo|trial]]. Originally greeting the [[Death penalty|death sentence]] with tumultuous applause, the individual's enthusiasm waned as pirate [[Chaelt]] brought to<ref name="SC 106" /> her<ref name="SC 106 AD">{{SkeletonCrew|Zero Friends Again}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> fellow crew members' attention that the verdict had been passed without respecting the [[Pirate's Code]]. Tasked with overseeing the trial, pirate [[Snobbius Snee]] conceded that the [[Right of Last Appeal]] had to be honored, clearing the way for Silvo to deliver his speech. The helmeted individual listened carefully as the former captain promised to lead his one-time comrades to the isolated [[planet]] of [[At Attin]], rumored to yield the eternal treasure of infinite [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. Silvo's appeal inspired Brutus to alter his verdict and spare Silvo's life pending their arrival on the isolated world.<ref name="SC 106" /> The pirate was later present after [[Glerb]] was killed by the Barrier around At Attin, when Brutus prepared to execute Silvo, but Chaelt saved her former captain by warning her comrades that a ship had exited from the hyperspace. Some [[time]] later, whem Silvo killed Brutus and became captain again, the pirate re-joined him alongside the other crew members.<ref name="SC 107">{{SkeletonCrew|We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
The helmeted pirate was a [[Color|white]]-skinned [[Klatooinian]].<ref name="SC 102" />

==Equipment==
The pirate donned a helmet upon their head and an [[Armor|armpiece]] on their left shoulder. In addition, they sported a light-green [[cape]] covering the right side of their torso and a brown [[Clothing|strap]] across the chest.<ref name="SC 106" />

==Behind the scenes==
The helmeted pirate debuted in "[[Way, Way Out Past the Barrier]]," the second episode of the ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' television series,<ref name="SC 102" /> which premiered on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref>
